submission.justification: R2 at 2 cm gives the best simulated pi/K separation at 10 GeV/c (4.64 sigma, versus 3.83 for R3 at 4 cm and 2.97 for R1 at 2 cm). The hard constraint, at most 10% transparency loss after humidity ageing, could NOT be verified for any candidate, because no ageing-loss data was found. No candidate can be shown to be eligible, so R2 is not confirmed to satisfy it either. This recommendation is conditional: ageing data for R2 must be obtained and confirmed at or below 10% loss before adoption. If R2 fails, fall back to R3 at 4 cm (3.83 sigma), subject to the same verification.
